def process_input():
    input_str = input()
    characters = list(input_str)
    total_pairs = 0
    index = 0
    while index < len(characters):
        next_index = index
        while next_index < len(characters) and characters[next_index] == characters[index]:
            next_index += 1
        if (next_index - index) % 2 == 0:
            total_pairs += 1
        index = next_index
    print(total_pairs)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process_input()
